   3. Audit Plan for the Regulatory Audit of “SMR-300 Concrete Strengthened Steel Structures
      Design and Analysis Methodology Licensing Topical Report,” (ML26033A013)

By letter dated December 2, 2025 (ML25336A060), SMR, LLC, a Holtec International Company
(Holtec), submitted Licensing Topical Report (LTR) HI-2251825, Revision 0, “SMR-300
Concrete Strengthened Steel Structures Design and Analysis Methodology Licensing Topical
Report” (Reference 1) to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC). The NRC accepted
the LTR for review (Reference 2) and issued the audit plan (Reference 3).

The purpose of this letter is to submit Revision 1 of this licensing topical report.

Enclosure 1 contains the non-public proprietary information version of the LTR Revision 1, and
Holtec requests that such information be withheld from public disclosure in accordance with the
affidavit provided in Enclosure 3. Enclosure 2 contains the public redacted version of
Enclosure 1.

If you have any questions or require any additional information, please contact Jacob Dolecki,
Senior Manager – Licensing & Engineering Programs, jdolecki@holtec.com or 856-797-0900.
